cause: unit.book was silently overloaded for two purposes -- physical-file lookup (token_closure_rows/CorpusLines) and engine-consumer-table lookup (classify()'s engine_book_for) -- both of which require the book directory ACTUALLY WALKED, not the true reporting attribution. The first regen (--allow-stamp-loss) silently downgraded 7 CRB race units from literal-verified/static to grounded/display; the second regen silently downgraded 16 companion units from grounded to not-ingested (companion_absent_from_bestiary_1_companion_tables). Neither was caught by any existing test -- caught only by diffing every unit's doneness_verdict before vs after and demanding zero transitions.
